an4.87:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇamacalo hoti?
an4.87:2.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu sekho hoti paṭipado
an4.87:2.4: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave rañño khattiyassa muddhāvasittassa jeṭṭho putto abhiseko anabhisitto-m-acalapatto,
an4.87:2.5: evam eva kho bhikkhave bhikkhu sekho hoti paṭipado anuttaraṃ yogakkhemaṃ patthayamāno viharati.
an4.87:2.6: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇamacalo hoti. 3.
an4.87:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapuṇḍarīko hoti?
an4.87:3.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati, no ca kho aṭṭha vimokhe kāyena phassitvā viharati.
an4.87:3.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapuṇḍarīko hoti. 4.
an4.87:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapadumo hoti?
an4.87:4.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu āsavānaṃ khayā . . . upasampajja viharati aṭṭha ca vimokhe kāyena phassitvā viharati.
an4.87:4.3: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇapadumo hoti. 5.
an4.87:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave puggalo samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo hoti?
an4.87:5.2: Idha bhikkhave bhikkhu yācito va bahulaṃ cīvaraṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito, yācito va bahulaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito, yācito va bahulaṃ senāsanaṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito, yācito va bahulaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjati appaṃ ayācito.
an4.87:5.3: Yehi kho pana sabrahmacārihī saddhiṃ viharati tyāssa manāpen' eva bahulaṃ kāyakammena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena, manāpen' eva bahulaṃ vacīkammena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena, manāpen' eva bahulaṃ manokammena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena,
an4.87:5.4: manāpaṃ yeva upahāraṃ upaharanti appaṃ amanāpaṃ.
an4.87:5.5: Yāni kho pana tāni vedayitāni pittasamuṭṭhānāni vā semhasamuṭṭhānāni vā vātasamuṭṭhānāni vā sannipātikāni vā utupariṇāmajāni vā visamaparihārajāni vā opakkamikāni vā kammavipākajāni vā tān' assa na bahud eva uppajjanti, appābādho hoti,
an4.87:5.6: catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī hoti akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an4.87:5.7: āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttiṃ paññāvimuttiṃ diṭṭh' eva dhamme abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati.
an4.87:5.8: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave puggalo samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo hoti. 6.
an4.87:6.1: Yaṃ hi taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo ti, mam eva taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vaddeya samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo ti.
an4.87:6.2: Ahaṃ bhikkhave yācito va bahulaṃ cīvaraṃ bahulaṃ paribhuñjāmi appaṃ ayācito, yācito va bahulaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ paribhuñjāmi appaṃ ayācito, yācito va bahulaṃ senāsanaṃ paribhuñjāmi appaṃ ayācito, yācito va bahulaṃ gilānapaccayabhesajjaparikkhāraṃ paribhuñjāmi appaṃ ayācito.
an4.87:6.3: Yehikhopana bhikkhūhisaddhiṃ viharāmitemamamanāpen' eva bahulaṃ kāyakammena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena . . . manāpen' eva bahulaṃ manokammena samudācaranti appaṃ amanāpena, manāpaṃ yeva upahāraṃ upaharanti appaṃ amanāpaṃ.
an4.87:6.4: Yāni kho pana tāni vedayitāni pittasamuṭṭhānāni vā semhasamuṭṭhānāni vā vātasamuṭṭhānāni vā sannipātakāni vā utupariṇāmajāni vā visamaparihārajāni vā opakkamikāni vā kammavipākajāni vā tāni me na bahud eva upajjanti, appābādho 'ham asmi,
an4.87:6.5: catunnaṃ kho panasmi jhānānaṃ abhicetasikānānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī akicchalābhī akasiralābhī,
an4.87:7.1: Yaṃ hi taṃ bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo ti, mam eva bhikkhave sammā vadamāno vadeyya samaṇesu samaṇasukhumālo ti.
an4.87:7.2: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 88. 1.
